methods.label: Determine both middle-term signs
methods.explanation: \(16=4^2\), so the middle term is \(kx=\pm2\cdot x\cdot4=\pm8x\), and \(k=8\) or \(-8\).
methods.levelReason: The grade 8 perfect-square pattern gives both possible signs directly.
